segments.speaker: Oliver
segments.intention: 小心提出一个可承受的开头

segments.text: One page, no questions afterwards. And permission to be bad at it.
segments.speaker: Oliver
segments.intention: 把具体条件和真正的担心连在一起；结束后给静音的玩家问句留一个交流节拍

segments.text: I'll ask. If I can read my own words, I can say that much.
segments.speaker: Oliver
segments.intention: 自己作决定，稍微恢复行动感

segments.speaker: Nora
segments.intention: Nora 自然接话，短而明确

segments.text: A page, no questions. And you can change your mind before we begin.
segments.speaker: Nora
segments.intention: 承诺条件并归还选择权，连贯地说给同一个人

segments.text: This isn't an audition. Nobody here needs to earn their chair.
segments.speaker: Nora
segments.intention: 平静消除被评判的压力

segments.text: Oliver turns the folded page over.
segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.intention: 旁白描述纸张动作，不表演角色的情绪

segments.text: The conversation pauses long enough for him to breathe.
segments.speaker: 旁白
segments.intention: 说完之后真的给他留出空间

segments.speaker: Oliver
segments.intention: Oliver 调整呼吸后开口，尝试的意愿开始清晰

segments.text: Or listen, and bring a page next time. Both feel real now.
segments.speaker: Oliver
segments.intention: 把两个选择与释然收束连成一个意思，避免每个消息框重新起调

notes: Dialogue-only audition; player clarify prompt remains silent, represented by a 1.05s beat, not full interactive reading time.
70-character synthesis cap retained, including optional expression tags.
All spoken lexical content preserved; source-panel boundaries do not dictate synthesis boundaries.
